title: Leakage-safe regime backtesting
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for made-up and historical statistical validation hygiene using purged and embargoed expanding-window walk-forward splits, volatility-regime Rank IC and ICIR, turnover cost accounting and multiple-testing deflation, strictly never as financial, investment or trading advice.
boundaries: Strictly statistical validation hygiene on made-up or historical panel series: never financial, investment or trading advice.
No orders, trades, position recommendations or brokerage connections exist anywhere in this pack.
Training folds must purge forward-label horizon overlaps before test windows and enforce embargo buffers.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for purged walk-forward statistical validation hygiene, regime Rank IC, turnover drag and multiple-testing deflation, never as financial advice

value.lets_workers: Audit time-series model evaluations strictly for statistical validation hygiene (never as financial or trading advice): build purged and embargoed expanding-window walk-forward splits, compute tie-aware Spearman Rank IC and ICIR across causal volatility regimes, deduct L1 turnover drag, and deflate Sharpe statistics for the number of tested configurations.
value.not_for: Financial advice, investment recommendations, order generation, live trading or brokerage interaction.

flow.when: Construct and audit expanding-window walk-forward folds with horizon purging and embargo bars.
Stratify Spearman Rank IC and ICIR across causal volatility regimes and deduct turnover drag.
Apply skewness/kurtosis-adjusted multiple-testing deflation across all evaluated trials.

value.worked_example: Made-up 4-unit fictional panel (SERIES_A.X..SERIES_D.X) recomputed in test_regime_backtest.py: verifies 3 leakage-free purged walk-forward folds, stratifies Rank IC across low/mid/high volatility regimes, accounts for 10 bps turnover drag and evaluates 12-trial Deflated Sharpe probability.

nouns.title: Guardrail: strictly statistical validation hygiene, never financial or trading advice
nouns.category_reason: Establishes the non-advisory statistical hygiene boundary across every task and artifact.

value.rule: Outputs measure statistical out-of-sample hygiene on made-up or historical panels only; no task recommends securities, sizes live capital, or connects to any broker or exchange.
value.how_it_is_checked: Pack boundaries, schema fields and CLI help enforce diagnostic-only statistical hygiene outputs.

nouns.title: Guardrail: purge training observations whose forward target horizon overlaps the test fold
nouns.category_reason: Prevents multi-bar forward target overlap from leaking test realizations into training.

value.rule: Every training index t satisfies t + label_horizon_bars <= test_start in walk-forward splits and obeys embargo_bars after any validation block.
value.how_it_is_checked: verify_split_hygiene audits every fold and blocks evaluation when leakage_free is false.

nouns.title: Guardrail: penalize selection bias across all tested hyperparameter and feature trials
nouns.category_reason: Prevents data-mined configurations from passing on raw single-test Sharpe ratios.

value.rule: deflated_sharpe_ratio raises the null benchmark SR_0 with num_trials and adjusts variance for sample skewness and kurtosis.
value.how_it_is_checked: run_validation_audit requires deflated_sharpe_prob >= min_dsr_prob alongside positive net cumulative score.

nouns.title: Specification: purged walk-forward splits, causal volatility regimes, turnover drag and DSR gate
nouns.category_reason: Defines deterministic split, regime, cost and multiple-testing validation parameters.

nouns.title: Evaluation rules: tie-aware Spearman Rank IC, L1 turnover drag and Euler-Mascheroni trial deflation
Tool card: purged walk-forward split auditor, regime IC calculator and multiple-testing deflator
nouns.category_reason: Tested standard-library Python package pinned by path, file count and digest.

value.name: Leakage-safe regime backtesting
value.runtime: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only.
does: Generates expanding-window walk-forward and blocked K-fold splits with horizon purging and embargo checks.
Computes Spearman Rank IC and ICIR across causal low, mid and high volatility regimes plus linear turnover cost drag.
Computes skewness/kurtosis-adjusted Deflated Sharpe probability across num_trials.
does_not: Provide financial, investment or trading advice, generate orders or connect to any brokerage or market venue.

nouns.title: Template: statistical split-hygiene, regime IC, turnover and multiple-testing receipt

value.describes: a non-advisory statistical validation receipt reporting split leakage status, regime Rank IC, turnover drag and Deflated Sharpe probability

nouns.title: Worked example input: made-up 4-series fictional panel (SERIES_A.X..SERIES_D.X) for hygiene checks
nouns.category_reason: Purely made-up statistical fixture recomputed by test_regime_backtest.py.

nouns.title: Worked example output: recomputed non-advisory statistical validation hygiene receipt

verbs.title: Construct and audit purged and embargoed expanding-window walk-forward splits
verbs.summary: Generate expanding-window walk-forward folds that purge forward-label horizons before each test window, enforce after-test embargo buffers, and audit zero index or horizon leakage.
verbs.outcome: Verified walk-forward fold indices and zero-leakage audit report.

slots.name: split_config
slots.description: Pin of n_bars, min_train_bars, test_bars, label_horizon_bars and embargo_bars.

steps: Run generate_purged_walk_forward_splits on the panel length and horizon config.
Run verify_split_hygiene and confirm leakage_free == true.

acceptance.check: verify_split_hygiene returns leakage_free == true with empty violations.

verbs.title: Compute regime-stratified Rank IC/ICIR and turnover cost drag
verbs.summary: Evaluate tie-aware Spearman Rank IC and ICIR across causal low, mid and high volatility regimes and deduct linear L1 turnover drag from made-up periodic scores.
verbs.outcome: Regime-stratified Rank IC/ICIR table and net-of-turnover periodic series.

slots.name: out_of_sample_panel
slots.description: Pin of out-of-sample causal volatility, predictions, weights and realized outcomes.

steps: Compute Rank IC and ICIR per causal volatility bucket with compute_regime_ic_summary.

acceptance.check: compute_regime_ic_summary and account_turnover_costs reproduce regime ICs and net_cumulative.

verbs.title: Evaluate multiple-testing Deflated Sharpe hygiene gate
verbs.summary: Adjust the net out-of-sample Sharpe statistic for skewness, kurtosis and the expected maximum across num_trials to emit a non-advisory statistical hygiene receipt.
verbs.outcome: A conforming validation-receipt recording split hygiene, regime ICs, turnover drag and Deflated Sharpe probability.

slots.name: regime_and_cost_summary
slots.description: Pin of net periodic series and total trial count.

steps: Run deflated_sharpe_ratio with the exact total num_trials evaluated.
Validate the full output against template.validation-receipt.

acceptance.check: Output passes schema validation against template.validation-receipt.
